article.title: Keisha Lance Bottoms and Rick Jackson agree to October debate as Georgia gubernatorial race tightens
article.summary: Republican Rick Jackson and Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms will take the debate stage in October for a gubernatorial town hall as margins tighten between the two candidates vying to lead Georgia. Atlanta News First reported Monday that Jackson and Bottoms have agreed to participate in a live debate on Oct. 6 in Atlanta. Erik Schrader, […]

article.title: Susan Collins' Superpower Against Troy Jackson?
article.summary: With only a few months left in the campaign, Jackson has limited time to tell his story while simultaneously redefining an opponent who is already a well-known commodity to her supporters and detractors.

article.title: Troy Jackson Cosponsored Bill Sending Millions of Taxpayer Dollars to His Son's Lobbying Client
article.summary: As president of the Maine Senate, Troy Jackson, now the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Republican incumbent Susan Collins, cosponsored a bill sending millions of taxpayer dollars to a state academy that employed his son as its designated lobbyist, a Washington Free Beacon review found.The postTroy Jackson Cosponsored Bill Sending Millions of Taxpayer Dollars to His Son's Lobbying Clientappeared first on.
